'''XN-D1''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who was obsessed with dissecting biological life. [[Gender/Legends|He]] maintained a number of laboratories where he conducted experiments, and one of those laboratories was discovered and raided for research data.<ref name="Mission" />
